name: SPY Returns Across Yield & VIX Macro Regimes with Panic-to-Recovery Transitions & GLD Hedge Analysis
description: Extended macro regime study on SPY with GLD hedge analysis. Part 1: Daily returns across 4 regimes defined by 10Y yield direction (60-day ROC of DGS10) and VIX level (above/below 20). Part 2: Panic-to-recovery regime transitions (R4 crisis → R1 risk-on) with forward return analysis. Part 3 (NEW): GLD as a crisis hedge — summary table comparing SPY vs GLD performance in-crisis vs out-of-crisis, cumulative return chart on crisis days only, SPY vs GLD drawdown from peak over full period, and scatter plot of SPY vs GLD daily returns during crisis with regression line.
source:
# =============================================================================
# SPY RETURNS ACROSS YIELD & VIX MACRO REGIMES + PANIC-TO-RECOVERY TRANSITIONS
# =============================================================================
# Part 1: Regime analysis (original)
#   Regimes defined by two axes:
#     1. 10Y Treasury yield direction: 60-day ROC of DGS10 (>0 = Rising, <=0 = Falling)
#     2. VIX level: High (>20) vs Low (<=20)
#   Four regimes:
#     R1: Rising Yields + Low VIX   (risk-on tightening)
#     R2: Rising Yields + High VIX  (stress tightening)
#     R3: Falling Yields + Low VIX  (calm easing)
#     R4: Falling Yields + High VIX (flight to safety / crisis)
#
# Part 2: Panic-to-recovery transition event study (new)
#   Detects regime flip from R4 (crisis) -> R1 (risk-on recovery)
#   Computes forward returns at 1d, 5d, 10d, 20d, 40d, 60d
#   Compares panic-flip transitions vs all R1 entries
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
daily_ret = returns(period=1)(close)
bar_ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# MACRO DATA
# =============================================================================

# 10Y Treasury yield (DGS10)
dgs10_data = common_economic_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.Treasury10Y)()
dgs10 = ffill(dgs10_data.result)

# VIX (VIXCLS)
vix_data = common_economic_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.VIX)()
vix = ffill(vix_data.result)

# =============================================================================
# REGIME CLASSIFICATION
# =============================================================================

# Yield direction: 60-day rate of change
yield_roc = roc(period=60)(dgs10)
is_yield_rising = yield_roc > 0

# VIX level threshold
is_vix_high = vix > 20

# Four regimes
is_r1 = is_yield_rising and (is_vix_high == False)       # Rising Yields + Low VIX
is_r2 = is_yield_rising and is_vix_high                   # Rising Yields + High VIX
is_r3 = (is_yield_rising == False) and (is_vix_high == False)  # Falling Yields + Low VIX
is_r4 = (is_yield_rising == False) and is_vix_high         # Falling Yields + High VIX

# =============================================================================
# REGIME METRICS (original)
# =============================================================================

# Daily returns per regime
ret_r1 = where(is_r1, daily_ret)
ret_r2 = where(is_r2, daily_ret)
ret_r3 = where(is_r3, daily_ret)
ret_r4 = where(is_r4, daily_ret)

# Hit rate (positive day = 1, negative = 0) per regime
hit_r1 = where(is_r1, 1.0 if daily_ret > 0 else 0.0)
hit_r2 = where(is_r2, 1.0 if daily_ret > 0 else 0.0)
hit_r3 = where(is_r3, 1.0 if daily_ret > 0 else 0.0)
hit_r4 = where(is_r4, 1.0 if daily_ret > 0 else 0.0)

# Day count per regime (1 on regime day, null otherwise)
count_r1 = where(is_r1, 1.0)
count_r2 = where(is_r2, 1.0)
count_r3 = where(is_r3, 1.0)
count_r4 = where(is_r4, 1.0)

# Annualized return per regime: avg daily * 252
ann_r1 = where(is_r1, daily_ret * 252.0)
ann_r2 = where(is_r2, daily_ret * 252.0)
ann_r3 = where(is_r3, daily_ret * 252.0)
ann_r4 = where(is_r4, daily_ret * 252.0)

# Pct of total time (1 on regime day, 0 otherwise — Mean gives fraction)
pct_r1 = 1.0 if is_r1 else 0.0
pct_r2 = 1.0 if is_r2 else 0.0
pct_r3 = 1.0 if is_r3 else 0.0
pct_r4 = 1.0 if is_r4 else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# CUMULATIVE RETURN BY REGIME (original line chart)
# =============================================================================

cum_ret_r1_raw = daily_ret if is_r1 else 0.0
cum_ret_r2_raw = daily_ret if is_r2 else 0.0
cum_ret_r3_raw = daily_ret if is_r3 else 0.0
cum_ret_r4_raw = daily_ret if is_r4 else 0.0

cum_ret_r1_clean = cum_ret_r1_raw if is_valid(cum_ret_r1_raw) else 0.0
cum_ret_r2_clean = cum_ret_r2_raw if is_valid(cum_ret_r2_raw) else 0.0
cum_ret_r3_clean = cum_ret_r3_raw if is_valid(cum_ret_r3_raw) else 0.0
cum_ret_r4_clean = cum_ret_r4_raw if is_valid(cum_ret_r4_raw) else 0.0

cum_r1 = cumulative()(cum_ret_r1_clean)
cum_r2 = cumulative()(cum_ret_r2_clean)
cum_r3 = cumulative()(cum_ret_r3_clean)
cum_r4 = cumulative()(cum_ret_r4_clean)

# =============================================================================
# GROUPED BAR CHART DATA (original)
# =============================================================================

ret_rising_low = where(is_r1, daily_ret)
ret_rising_high = where(is_r2, daily_ret)
ret_falling_low = where(is_r3, daily_ret)
ret_falling_high = where(is_r4, daily_ret)

# =============================================================================
# PART 2: PANIC-TO-RECOVERY TRANSITION DETECTION
# =============================================================================

# Detect first day entering R1 (Rising Yields + Low VIX)
# Entry = R1 is true today AND was false yesterday
entry_r1 = is_r1 and not (is_r1 >> 1)

# How many bars since we were last in R4 (crisis: Falling Yields + High VIX)?
bars_since_crisis = barssince()(is_r4)

# Panic-flip: entering R1 within 10 bars of the crisis regime
# coalesce handles the case where R4 was never active (returns 9999)
bars_since_crisis_safe = coalesce(bars_since_crisis, 9999)
is_panic_flip = entry_r1 and (bars_since_crisis_safe <= 10)

# Comparison group: all entries into R1 regardless of prior regime
is_all_r1_entry = entry_r1

# =============================================================================
# FORWARD RETURNS FROM SIGNAL DAYS
# =============================================================================

# Forward cumulative returns at various horizons using forward_returns
fwd_1d = forward_returns(period=1, return_type=ReturnType.simple)(close)
fwd_5d = forward_returns(period=5, return_type=ReturnType.simple)(close)
fwd_10d = forward_returns(period=10, return_type=ReturnType.simple)(close)
fwd_20d = forward_returns(period=20, return_type=ReturnType.simple)(close)
fwd_40d = forward_returns(period=40, return_type=ReturnType.simple)(close)
fwd_60d = forward_returns(period=60, return_type=ReturnType.simple)(close)

# --- Panic-flip forward returns (sparse: value on event days, null otherwise) ---
pf_fwd_1d = where(is_panic_flip, fwd_1d)
pf_fwd_5d = where(is_panic_flip, fwd_5d)
pf_fwd_10d = where(is_panic_flip, fwd_10d)
pf_fwd_20d = where(is_panic_flip, fwd_20d)
pf_fwd_40d = where(is_panic_flip, fwd_40d)
pf_fwd_60d = where(is_panic_flip, fwd_60d)

# --- All R1 entry forward returns (sparse) ---
ar1_fwd_1d = where(is_all_r1_entry, fwd_1d)
ar1_fwd_5d = where(is_all_r1_entry, fwd_5d)
ar1_fwd_10d = where(is_all_r1_entry, fwd_10d)
ar1_fwd_20d = where(is_all_r1_entry, fwd_20d)
ar1_fwd_40d = where(is_all_r1_entry, fwd_40d)
ar1_fwd_60d = where(is_all_r1_entry, fwd_60d)

# --- Panic-flip summary metrics ---
pf_count = where(is_panic_flip, 1.0)
pf_hit_20d = where(is_panic_flip, 1.0 if fwd_20d > 0 else 0.0)
pf_hit_60d = where(is_panic_flip, 1.0 if fwd_60d > 0 else 0.0)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS — ORIGINAL REGIME ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

# --- Summary Table: 4 regimes × 5 metrics ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='SPY Daily Returns by Macro Regime',
        row_size=4,
        col_size=5,
        row_headers=[
            'Rising Yields + Low VIX',
            'Rising Yields + High VIX',
            'Falling Yields + Low VIX',
            'Falling Yields + High VIX'
        ],
        col_headers=['Avg Daily Return', 'Ann. Return', 'Hit Rate', 'Day Count', '% of Time'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3, grid_color=Color.Amber),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_color=Color.Amber),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3, grid_color=Color.Slate),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_color=Color.Slate),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3, grid_color=Color.Gray),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_color=Color.Gray),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='Macro Regime Analysis',
    order=0
)(ret_r1, ann_r1, hit_r1, count_r1, pct_r1, ret_r2, ann_r2, hit_r2, count_r2, pct_r2, ret_r3, ann_r3, hit_r3, count_r3, pct_r3, ret_r4, ann_r4, hit_r4, count_r4, pct_r4)

# --- Chart 1: Annualized Return by Regime (bar chart) ---
xy_bars(
    title='Calm Easing Wins: SPY Annualized Return by Macro Regime',
    category='Macro Regime Analysis',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_label='Avg Annualized Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Rising + Low VIX', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Rising + High VIX', color=Color.Amber),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Falling + Low VIX', color=Color.Slate),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Falling + High VIX', color=Color.Gray)
    ]),
    order=1
)(ann_r1, ann_r2, ann_r3, ann_r4)

# --- Chart 2: Cumulative Return by Regime Over Time ---
xy_lines(
    title='Cumulative SPY Return Attributed to Each Regime',
    category='Macro Regime Analysis',
    y_axis_label='Cumulative Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Rising + Low VIX', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Rising + High VIX', color=Color.Amber),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Falling + Low VIX', color=Color.Slate),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Falling + High VIX', color=Color.Gray)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Breakeven')
    ]),
    order=2
)(bar_ts, cum_r1, cum_r2, cum_r3, cum_r4)

# --- Chart 3: Avg Daily Return by Yield Direction, Sub-Split by VIX ---
xy_bars(
    title='VIX Amplifies Yield Regime Impact on SPY',
    category='Macro Regime Analysis',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_label='Avg Daily Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Low VIX', color=Color.Blue, stack='Rising Yields'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='High VIX', color=Color.Amber, stack='Rising Yields'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Low VIX', color=Color.Blue, stack='Falling Yields'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='High VIX', color=Color.Amber, stack='Falling Yields')
    ]),
    order=3
)(ret_rising_low, ret_rising_high, ret_falling_low, ret_falling_high)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS — PANIC-TO-RECOVERY TRANSITION ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

# --- Summary Table: Panic-Flip Transition Stats ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Panic-to-Recovery Transition Stats (R4 → R1)',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=7,
        row_headers=['Crisis → Recovery'],
        col_headers=['Events', 'Avg +20d', 'Hit Rate @20d', 'Avg +60d', 'Hit Rate @60d', 'Max +60d', 'Min +60d'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=5, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_color=Color.Emerald),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=6, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_color=Color.Red)
        ]
    ),
    category='Panic-to-Recovery Transitions',
    order=4
)(pf_count, pf_fwd_20d, pf_hit_20d, pf_fwd_60d, pf_hit_60d, pf_fwd_60d, pf_fwd_60d)

# --- Chart 4: Avg Forward Returns — Panic-Flip vs All R1 Entries ---
xy_bars(
    title='Crisis Origins Boost Recovery: Panic-Flip vs All R1 Entry Forward Returns',
    category='Panic-to-Recovery Transitions',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_label='Avg Forward Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Panic-Flip +1d', color=Color.Blue, stack='Panic-Flip'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Panic-Flip +5d', color=Color.Blue, stack='Panic-Flip'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Panic-Flip +10d', color=Color.Blue, stack='Panic-Flip'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Panic-Flip +20d', color=Color.Blue, stack='Panic-Flip'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Panic-Flip +40d', color=Color.Blue, stack='Panic-Flip'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Panic-Flip +60d', color=Color.Blue, stack='Panic-Flip'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='All R1 +1d', color=Color.Slate, stack='All R1 Entries'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='All R1 +5d', color=Color.Slate, stack='All R1 Entries'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='All R1 +10d', color=Color.Slate, stack='All R1 Entries'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='All R1 +20d', color=Color.Slate, stack='All R1 Entries'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='All R1 +40d', color=Color.Slate, stack='All R1 Entries'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='All R1 +60d', color=Color.Slate, stack='All R1 Entries')
    ]),
    order=5
)(pf_fwd_1d, pf_fwd_5d, pf_fwd_10d, pf_fwd_20d, pf_fwd_40d, pf_fwd_60d, ar1_fwd_1d, ar1_fwd_5d, ar1_fwd_10d, ar1_fwd_20d, ar1_fwd_40d, ar1_fwd_60d)

# --- Chart 5: Avg Cumulative Return Path — Panic-Flip vs All R1 ---
# Uses xy_lines with x = horizon days, y = avg forward return at each horizon
# Two lines: panic-flip events vs all R1 entries
xy_lines(
    title='Recovery Path: Avg Cumulative Return After Regime Entry (Day 0-60)',
    category='Panic-to-Recovery Transitions',
    y_axis_label='Avg Cumulative Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Panic-Flip +1d', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Panic-Flip +5d', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Panic-Flip +10d', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Panic-Flip +20d', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Panic-Flip +40d', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Panic-Flip +60d', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='All R1 +1d', color=Color.Slate),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='All R1 +5d', color=Color.Slate),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='All R1 +10d', color=Color.Slate),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='All R1 +20d', color=Color.Slate),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='All R1 +40d', color=Color.Slate),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='All R1 +60d', color=Color.Slate)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Breakeven')
    ]),
    order=6
)(bar_ts, pf_fwd_1d, pf_fwd_5d, pf_fwd_10d, pf_fwd_20d, pf_fwd_40d, pf_fwd_60d, ar1_fwd_1d, ar1_fwd_5d, ar1_fwd_10d, ar1_fwd_20d, ar1_fwd_40d, ar1_fwd_60d)

# --- Event Markers: Panic-to-Recovery Transitions on SPY ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Panic → Recovery',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='SPY Price', type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='+20d Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='+60d Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Signal', table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(close, fwd_20d, fwd_60d, is_panic_flip)

# =============================================================================
# PART 3: GLD HEDGE ANALYSIS — GOLD VS SPY IN CRISIS REGIME
# =============================================================================

# --- GLD Data ---
gld_src = reference_stocks(ticker="GLD")()
gld_close = ffill(gld_src.c)
gld_daily_ret = returns(period=1)(gld_close)

# --- Crisis vs Non-Crisis Flag ---
is_not_crisis = not is_r4

# =============================================================================
# SUMMARY TABLE DATA: SPY vs GLD, In-Crisis vs Out-of-Crisis
# =============================================================================

# SPY in crisis
spy_ret_crisis = where(is_r4, daily_ret)
spy_ann_crisis = where(is_r4, daily_ret * 252.0)
spy_hit_crisis = where(is_r4, 1.0 if daily_ret > 0 else 0.0)

# SPY outside crisis
spy_ret_nocrisis = where(is_not_crisis, daily_ret)
spy_ann_nocrisis = where(is_not_crisis, daily_ret * 252.0)
spy_hit_nocrisis = where(is_not_crisis, 1.0 if daily_ret > 0 else 0.0)

# GLD in crisis
gld_ret_crisis = where(is_r4, gld_daily_ret)
gld_ann_crisis = where(is_r4, gld_daily_ret * 252.0)
gld_hit_crisis = where(is_r4, 1.0 if gld_daily_ret > 0 else 0.0)

# GLD outside crisis
gld_ret_nocrisis = where(is_not_crisis, gld_daily_ret)
gld_ann_nocrisis = where(is_not_crisis, gld_daily_ret * 252.0)
gld_hit_nocrisis = where(is_not_crisis, 1.0 if gld_daily_ret > 0 else 0.0)

# =============================================================================
# CUMULATIVE RETURN ON CRISIS DAYS ONLY (SPY vs GLD)
# =============================================================================

spy_crisis_contrib = daily_ret if is_r4 else 0.0
spy_crisis_contrib_clean = spy_crisis_contrib if is_valid(spy_crisis_contrib) else 0.0
cum_spy_crisis = cumulative()(spy_crisis_contrib_clean)

gld_crisis_contrib = gld_daily_ret if is_r4 else 0.0
gld_crisis_contrib_clean = gld_crisis_contrib if is_valid(gld_crisis_contrib) else 0.0
cum_gld_crisis = cumulative()(gld_crisis_contrib_clean)

# =============================================================================
# DRAWDOWN FROM PEAK — FULL PERIOD (SPY vs GLD)
# =============================================================================

spy_peak = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Max)(close)
spy_drawdown = (close - spy_peak) / spy_peak

gld_peak = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Max)(gld_close)
gld_drawdown = (gld_close - gld_peak) / gld_peak

# =============================================================================
# SCATTER DATA: SPY vs GLD Daily Returns in Crisis Regime Only
# =============================================================================

spy_ret_scatter = where(is_r4, daily_ret)
gld_ret_scatter = where(is_r4, gld_daily_ret)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS — GLD HEDGE ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

# --- Table: SPY vs GLD in Crisis vs Non-Crisis ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='SPY vs GLD: Crisis Regime Hedge Comparison',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=6,
        row_headers=['In Crisis (R4)', 'Outside Crisis'],
        col_headers=['SPY Avg Daily', 'SPY Ann. Return', 'SPY Hit Rate', 'GLD Avg Daily', 'GLD Ann. Return', 'GLD Hit Rate'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3, grid_color=Color.Red),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_color=Color.Red),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
